user.title: Connect to Arcane
user.description: Create an API key in Arcane under Settings → API Keys. All hosts (environments) are detected automatically.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Arcane
reconfigure.description: Change the URL or the API key. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Arcane at this URL.

abort.already_configured: This Arcane environment is already configured.

init.title: Arcane options
init.description: Leave the hosts empty for all. Events (arcane_container_state_changed, arcane_project_state_changed) can trigger automations. Vanished items are removed after the grace period (0 = never).

data.read_only: Read only (refuse start, stop, update, prune ...)

check_errors.title: Image update check failing on {host}

check_updates.name: Check for image updates
check_updates.description: Ask the registries whether newer images exist for all containers of the selected hosts.

update_all.name: Update all
update_all.description: Apply all pending container updates of the selected hosts, the same as Arcane's updater. Containers excluded in Arcane are skipped. Returns Arcane's counters per host.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only report what would be updated.

prune_images.name: Remove unused images
prune_images.description: Delete all images that no container uses on the selected hosts. Volumes, containers and networks are not touched. Returns how many images and how many bytes were freed per host.
